context: A boss reads morning financial news with his manager
purpose: Teach: 債務/日銀/インフレ/詐欺/独占/レート/マネー/倒産

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おはよう、ケンジ君。今朝の日銀の発表、見たか？
lines.en: Morning, Kenji. Did you catch the BOJ announcement this morning?
lines.style: Casual gruff morning greeting with curious opening question

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、見ました。インフレ対策で金利を上げるみたいですね。
lines.en: Yes, I saw it. Looks like they're raising rates to deal with inflation.
lines.style: Polite morning reply with light business briefing tone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ、おかげで為替レートも朝から大きく動いてるな。
lines.en: Yeah, and the exchange rate has been swinging since the open because of it.
lines.style: Thoughtful grunt with seasoned executive market observation

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、マネーの流れが急に変わると、現場も大変です。
lines.en: Right, when the money flow shifts suddenly, the front lines really struggle.
lines.style: Sympathetic agreeable reply with mild concerned undertone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ところで、あの大手商社、債務がかなり膨らんでるって本当か？
lines.en: By the way, is it true that big trading company's debt is ballooning?
lines.style: Lowered curious tone shifting into discreet concerned probing

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、最悪の場合は倒産もあり得ると、朝刊に書いてありました。
lines.en: Yeah, the morning paper said bankruptcy is possible in the worst case.
lines.style: Hushed careful delivery befitting sensitive financial news report

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それに、確かあの会社、独占禁止法でも調査されてたよな？
lines.en: Plus, that company was under antitrust investigation too, wasn't it?
lines.style: Sharp recollecting tone with probing executive follow-up question

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。役員の投資詐欺の疑いまで出ているそうで。
lines.en: Exactly. There are even allegations of investment fraud by executives.
lines.style: Formal affirmation with measured grave informational delivery

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふん、率直に言って、嫌な朝だな。コーヒー、もう一杯頼む。
lines.en: Hmph, frankly, what a rough morning. Get me another coffee.
lines.style: Grumbling resigned exhale ending on casual office request

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。続報が入りましたら、すぐお持ちします。
lines.en: Of course. I'll bring updates as soon as they come in.
lines.style: Crisp deferential acknowledgment promising prompt follow-up action
